response.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT r.trdref COLLATE BINARY) AS trader_count FROM transactionrecord AS r JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref COLLATE BINARY = t.tradereg COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY t.tradekind), totals AS (SELECT AVG(trader_count) AS average_count, SUM(trader_count) AS total_count FROM per_type) SELECT p.tradekind, p.trader_count, 1.0 * p.trader_count / totals.total_count AS share_of_total, p.trader_count - totals.average_count AS above_average_by FROM per_type AS p CROSS JOIN totals WHERE p.trader_count > totals.average_count;
